Wiring Rev. 2503 Product Overview Many houses built before digital thermostats were popular do not have a common wire in the wall to power the thermostat. PRO1 Wi-Fi thermostats require 24VAC hardwire to operate. The C-Wire Adapter provides a solution to provide 24VAC power to PRO1 Wi-Fi thermostats in applications where a C wire is unavailable while retaining all control lines Y, G, W, etc. Adapter Mounting Holes Terminals Wires Diode Y AW G 2 Installation Steps Wiring Installation Steps 24 Volt Factory-installed jumper. Installation Manual Installation Steps (cont) 3. Relabel Existing Wires • G Wire: Repurpose the wire connected to the “G” terminal as the “C” wire. Note its color for later. • Y Wire: Repurpose the wire connected to the “Y” terminal as the Adapter Wire (AW). Note its color for later. Original Terminal R G Y W Wire Color New Adapter Terminal R C AW W Installation Steps Installation Steps (cont) 4. Connect the Thermostat Wires • Attach the repurposed “G” wire to the “C” terminal on the thermostat. • Connect the repurposed “Y” wire to the AW wire on the provided diode using the wire nut. • Wire the diode to the thermostat subbase using the “G” and “Y” terminals, matching the labels and wire colors for future reference. 5. Access the HVAC Equipment • Remove the front cover of your air handler to locate the control board. You should see the same terminals as on the thermostat. • Take a picture or note the terminal labels and wire colors for future reference. 5 Installation Steps Installation Steps (cont) 7. Connect the Wires to the Adapter • Reference the following wiring guide: • R wire = R terminal • G wire = C terminal • Y wire = AW terminal • W wire = W terminal • Ensure that all exposed wire ends are securely inserted into their quick-connect locations. Note: Exposed wires must be at least 3/4”. 6. Disconnect and Prepare Wires • Remove the existing wires from the control board terminals. • Strip 3/4” of insulation from each wire to prepare them for connection. 6 Installation Steps Installation Steps (cont) 8. Connect The Adapter Wires to the Control Board Connect each labeled wire from the C-wire adapter to the matching terminal on the control board. 9. Attach the C-Wire Adapter Mount the adapter inside the air handler using the included screws or adhesive pad. Ensure the wires are not constrained and have plenty of space. 10. Restore Power Turn the power back on for your HVAC equipment. 11. Final Test Verify that the compressor Y and fan G are functioning correctly. If issues arise, double-check the wiring at both the thermostat and the air handler. 7 8
